## What is Overlay?

Overlay is a free desktop app for Windows that adds a notch, like the Dynamic Island on iPhone and the notch on a MacBook, to the top of your screen. Closed, it shows what is happening right now: the song that is playing, your AI tool's usage, a reminder or your next meeting. Hover or click and it opens into a full set of tools, then tucks away again.

It runs locally. Overlay reads the logs your tools already keep on your PC and never uploads your data.

## Features

| | |
|---|---|
| **Now Playing** | The song, its cover and synced lyrics from Spotify or any player in the Windows media controls, with play, skip and volume. |
| **AI usage limits** | Session and weekly limits for Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Gemini CLI, OpenCode, GitHub Copilot CLI and Antigravity, tracked per model. When one runs low, continue in another tool with your context. |
| **Focus** | A Lock In timer with breaks, streaks and a week of history. |
| **Calendar** | Your next event and the day ahead from Google Calendar. |
| **Discord** | Your voice call in the notch: who is talking, with mute, deafen and leave. |
| **GitHub and LeetCode** | Today's contributions and your streaks. |
| **To-dos, notes and clipboard** | A short list, a scratch note and the last things you copied, synced with the Dashboard. |
| **Desk tools** | Hardware stats, weather, world clocks, calculator, colour picker, screenshots, a file shelf, local ports, downloads, file search and break reminders. |
| **Dashboard** | One window for history, settings, connections and your local account. |

## Install

1. Download **[Overlay-Setup.exe](https://github.com/pradhan-not-found/overlay-releases/releases/latest/download/Overlay-Setup.exe)**.
2. Run it and follow the setup. Overlay starts by itself and opens with Windows (you can turn that off).
3. Look for the notch at the top of your screen. Hover or click it to open.

Overlay updates itself in the background whenever a new version is published here.

**Requirements:** Windows 10 or Windows 11, 64-bit.

## Pricing

| Plan | Price | |
|---|---|---|
| Basic | $0, forever | The notch, Now Playing, Focus, Today, to-dos, notes, clipboard and hardware |
| Pro | $49 a year | Everything in Basic, AI usage for every tool, one-click handoff, synced lyrics |
| Lifetime | $149 once | Everything in Pro and every future update |

The Windows beta is free while it lasts.

## Privacy

Overlay works on your PC. Your account, notes, to-dos and history are stored locally, and AI usage is read from the logs your tools already write on your machine. Nothing is uploaded to Overlay.

## Frequently asked questions

**Is Overlay free?**
Yes. Basic is free forever, and the Windows beta is free while it lasts.

**Which versions of Windows are supported?**
Windows 10 and Windows 11, 64-bit.

**Which AI coding tools does Overlay track?**
Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Gemini CLI, OpenCode, GitHub Copilot CLI and Antigravity, with per-model token counts and plan limits.

**Does it work with Spotify?**
Yes, and with any player that appears in the Windows media controls.

**Does Overlay upload my data?**
No. Everything is read and stored on your PC.

**Windows says the installer is from an unknown publisher.**
Choose *More info → Run anyway*. Overlay is not code-signed yet.
